title: testjig: chat history registration and Message history end to end
description:
Design: docs/design/object-history.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: H20. Crates: jmap-testjig. Size: S.

Design: docs/design/object-history.md §5 'Capability advertisement', §10 'Decision-5 crates'.

Switch testjig's chat registration (crate-jmap-testjig/src/http.rs) to register_chat_handlers_with_history, with memory with_object_history, and keep register_chat_conditional after it if present. Add the chat types to the advertised supportedTypes.

Acceptance:
- Over HTTP: Message/get includeReplaced returns the edit versions; after the Message is deleted it returns only the live tombstone and restore ⇒ notFound.
- object_history_gaps is still empty.
- The Session advertises the chat types.
